# lightdash_project_ai_provider_credential (Resource)

Selects which organization AI provider credential a Lightdash project uses for AI features. Omit `credential_uuid` or set it to null to use the organization default credential.

Requires a token with permission to update project settings. Destroying this resource resets the project to the organization default (`credentialUuid: null` in the Lightdash API) unless `deletion_protection` is enabled.

`deletion_protection` is required. Imported resources default to `deletion_protection = true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lightdash_organization" "example" {
}

data "lightdash_project" "example" {
  project_uuid = var.project_uuid
}

resource "lightdash_project_ai_provider_credential" "example" {
  organization_uuid   = data.lightdash_organization.example.organization_uuid
  project_uuid        = data.lightdash_project.example.project_uuid
  credential_uuid     = var.credential_uuid
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) When set to `true`, prevents Terraform from resetting the project binding on destroy.
- `organization_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash organization.
- `project_uuid` (String) The UUID of the Lightdash project.

### Optional

- `credential_uuid` (String) Organization AI provider credential UUID for this project. Omit or leave unset to use the organization default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier: `organizations/<organization_uuid>/projects/<project_uuid>/ai_provider_credential`.
